title: SDD apply — cli
content:
All **15 CLI acceptance scenarios** are implemented and green on the existing starter (`go test ./...`).

### Surface
`list` · `check` (`--ci`) · `doctor` · `diff` · `run` · `get`/`set`/`delete` · `import`/`export` (`--reveal`) · `agent grant`/`revoke`

Secrets stay redacted by default. Agent writes need `--as-agent` + an active grant (TTL-enforced). Mutations append to `.envy/audit.jsonl` without plaintext secrets.

### This pass
- Aligned acceptance tests to SDD wording (`--env development`, bare `check` + `PORT=abc`, list presence after set/delete)
- CLI-level grant TTL expiry denial (`TestAgentGrantExpiresViaCLI`)
- Import/grant/revoke audit rows carry a key token

### Code review

## Standards
- Soft: some CLI handlers >50 lines; audit persist errors still soft-fail
- Judgement: flag-parser duplication; list-line presence checks duplicated in tests

## Spec
- All 15 scenarios covered at the CLI seam
- Partials: doctor gitignore is warn without `.git` (fail with `.git` — covered); deleted required keys still listed as ⚠ missing

**Summary:** Standards ~3 soft · Spec 0 blocking.

Committed as `5d3bea6`.
